Verified: MULTI → [stripe,etransfer,cash]; CHEQUE-only → [cheque]; STRIPE-only → [stripe]. Default selection = first accepted method (visual radio pre-selected).

All 3 Create pages (Individual /create-listing, Multi-Item /create-multi-item-listing, Storage /storage-auctions/create) expose exactly one data-testid='accepted-payment-methods-selector' AND zero legacy 'payment-stripe'/'payment-cash'/'payment-etransfer' testids in DOM.
